ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Directory Enumeration
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects technique used by MAZE ransomware to enumerate directories using Powershell Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*foreach.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ChildItem.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ErrorAction\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SilentlyContinue.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Out\\-File\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-append.*"))
